name: Admin verifies and advances a customer order
description: Verify a customer-created order appears in admin operations and payment/order statuses can be advanced through the backend.

planSteps.description: As a customer, add Linen Daily Notebook, log in with rafi.ahmad@example.com and RafStore#2026, checkout to recipient TestSprite Admin Order at Jalan TestSprite Admin Order Nomor 16 Jakarta, city Jakarta, province DKI Jakarta, postal 12345, and create the order.
Verify a new real RAF order number is generated and remember it.
Log out, log in as admin@rafstore.id with Admin#Raf2026, and open Pesanan.
Verify the remembered order appears with recipient TestSprite Admin Order, correct total Rp89.000, waiting payment, and no proof if none was uploaded.
Change payment status to Lunas and process status to Diproses, then reload the page.
Verify both updated statuses persist after reload.
